This integration brings **PRONOTE**, the school life software used by most French
schools, into Gladys: grades, homework, timetable, absences, correspondence book and unread
messages of a student — or of every child of a parent account.

It reads PRONOTE the way the PRONOTE app does, every few minutes, and publishes
what it finds as Gladys devices, scene triggers and dashboard widgets.

> PRONOTE and Index Éducation are not involved in this integration. It uses the
> open-source [pawnote](https://github.com/LiterateInk/Pawnote.js) library to speak
> to PRONOTE.

## Requirements

- Gladys **5.1 or later**.
- A PRONOTE **student** or **parent** account (teacher accounts are not supported).
- The address of your PRONOTE space, as shown by your browser, for example
  `https://0123456a.index-education.net/pronote/`.

## Configuration

In Gladys, open **Integrations → PRONOTE → Configuration**.

| Field                   | What to put                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PRONOTE address         | The address of the PRONOTE space. The end (`eleve.html`, `parent.html`) is not needed.                                                          |
| Kind of account         | **Student** for a student account, **Parent** for a parent account (one device per child).                                                      |
| Username / Password     | Your PRONOTE username and password.                                                                                                             |
| Refresh interval (min)  | How often PRONOTE is read. 30 minutes is plenty; the server is shared by the whole school.                                                      |
| Homework horizon        | How many days of homework are counted and listed, from the next school day (7 by default). During the holidays, the days count from the return. |
| Time zone of the school | `Europe/Paris` by default. Overseas schools: `Indian/Reunion`, `America/Martinique`, `Pacific/Noumea`…                                          |
| Detailed logs           | Turn on to understand a problem, then off again.                                                                                                |

Save, then press **Test the connection**: it tells you who is logged in and what was
found for each student.

After the first login, PRONOTE gives the integration a **session token** which
replaces the password for the next logins, as the PRONOTE mobile app does. It is
kept in the integration's own storage.

### Accounts that log in through an ENT

If you reach PRONOTE through your region's ENT (Mon Bureau Numérique, ENT77,
Skolengo…), you have no PRONOTE password. Use a **QR code** instead:

1. In PRONOTE, on a computer, open the menu next to your name and choose **QR code
   for the mobile app**. Pick a 4-digit code.
2. Scan the QR code with your phone camera (not with the PRONOTE app): the phone
   shows a text that starts with `{"jeton"`. Copy it.
3. In Gladys, press **Log in with a QR code**, paste the text and type the 4-digit
   code. Be quick: the QR code is valid for a few minutes only.

Leave the address, username and password fields empty, or fill in the address
only. The session is then kept the same way as after a password login.

## Devices

Press **Discover** (or wait for the first read) to see the devices, then create
them.

**One device per student**:

| Feature                          | Value                                                                         |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Overall average                  | The average of the current period, out of 20 (when the school shows it).      |
| Homework to do                   | The homework not done yet, due within the homework horizon.                   |
| Homework for the next school day | The homework not done yet, due on the next school day.                        |
| Absences (period)                | The absences of the current period.                                           |
| Delays (period)                  | The delays of the current period.                                             |
| Next lesson                      | Text, e.g. `14:00 MATHEMATIQUES (B12)` (with the date when it is not today).  |
| Next school day start            | Text, e.g. `08:00`: the first lesson that takes place on the next school day. |
| Last grade                       | Text, e.g. `MATHEMATIQUES 15/20 (12/10)`.                                     |

**One device for the account**: the number of **unread messages**.

The devices are read-only: nothing is changed on PRONOTE.

## Scenes

### Triggers

| Trigger                                      | When                                                                           | Variables                                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| A new grade is published                     | A grade appeared since the previous read.                                      | student name, subject, grade, out of, grade out of 20, grade as written, coefficient, class average, comment, date |
| New homework is given                        | Homework appeared or changed since the previous read.                          | student name, subject, description, due date                                                                       |
| A lesson is canceled                         | A lesson of the coming days is now canceled.                                   | student name, subject, date, start time, end time, PRONOTE status                                                  |
| An absence or delay is recorded              | The school recorded an absence or a delay.                                     | student name, kind (`absence` / `delay`), date, justified (`yes` / `no`), minutes late, reason                     |
| A note is written in the correspondence book | A teacher or the school wrote a note (observation, encouragement, book issue). | student name, kind (`issue` / `observation` / `encouragement` / `other`), title, subject, comment, date            |

Every trigger can be limited to one student. The first read after installing only
remembers what is already there: nothing is announced for the grades of the past
weeks.

### Actions

- **Read PRONOTE now**: updates the devices and widgets at once. What it finds new
  is announced by the triggers at the next timed read.
- **Get the day of a student**: for today, tomorrow or the next school day, gives
  the number of lessons, the start of the first one, the end of the last one, the
  canceled subjects, and the homework to do as a list ready to be read aloud.

Example: _every weekday at 07:00 → Get the day of a student (next school day) →
Say "First lesson at \{\{first_lesson\}\}. Homework: \{\{homework_text\}\}"_.

## Widgets

- **PRONOTE student**: the summary. Average, homework to do, absences, the next
  lesson, the next school day (only when it is not already the next lesson), the
  last grade and the unread messages. A **Refresh** button reads PRONOTE now. Its
  **List** setting (**None** by default) can add one of the lists below.

- **PRONOTE homework**: the homework of the homework horizon, each marked **Done**,
  **Not done**, **Today** or **Tomorrow**, as in PRONOTE, under a **To do** tile.

- **PRONOTE grades**: the average and the most recent grades, with the class
  average. Its **Number of grades** setting goes from 1 to 8 (8 by default): a
  Gladys list holds 8 rows at most.

- **PRONOTE correspondence book**: the notes of the teachers and the school
  (observations, encouragements, book issues) of the current period.

- **PRONOTE timetable**: the lessons of today, tomorrow or the next school day, with
  canceled lessons and tests flagged. Its **Days shown** setting (1 by default)
  widens it to a period of up to 8 days from that day: one row a day, with its
  hours and subjects, and the lessons when the row is opened. **Today** and
  **8** show today to D+7. Days without lessons (weekend, holidays) are left
  out. Its **Shift** setting (0 by default) moves it 1 to 7 school days further.
  For a paper-like timetable, one column a day, add the widget once per day and
  place them side by side: **Next school day** with **Shift** 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4
  shows the next five school days, weekends and holidays skipped.

Each widget has a **Student** setting: add a widget once per child. All show the
last read: opening a dashboard never calls PRONOTE.

## Buttons of the Configuration screen

- **Test the connection**: reads PRONOTE now and says what was found, or why not.
- **Log in with a QR code**: see above.
- **Forget the saved session**: deletes the saved session token (to change account,
  or after changing the password elsewhere).

## Troubleshooting

| Message                                         | What to do                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PRONOTE refused the username or password        | Check them in the PRONOTE website. Reading is paused until you save the configuration or test the connection.                                                                                                   |
| PRONOTE asks to set up the account security     | Log in once in the PRONOTE app or website to finish it (new password, PIN), then use the QR code login.                                                                                                         |
| The IP address was suspended                    | Too many failed logins or requests: the next read waits an hour, and the Refresh button and the scene action wait too. Do not press "Test the connection" until then.                                           |
| PRONOTE ended the session right after the login | PRONOTE refused a page to this account and closed the session. The next read waits an hour, like after a suspension, so the logins do not pile up. Send the integration logs to the developer if it comes back. |
| The server cannot be reached                    | Check the address. A busy server is tried again at the next read.                                                                                                                                               |

Turn on **Detailed logs** to see each step in the integration logs. Passwords and
tokens are never logged.

## Known limits

- **Teacher accounts** are not supported.
- PRONOTE has no notifications: news are found at each read, so a new grade shows
  up within the refresh interval.

## Your data

The password stays in Gladys' secret configuration. The session token is kept in
the integration's private storage; grades, homework and timetable are only kept in
memory and published to your Gladys. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings PRONOTE asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Getting started | `section` | No | The integration reads your PRONOTE space on the school's server, as the PRONOTE app does: grades, homework, timetable, absences, the correspondence book and unread messages. Fill in the address of the PRONOTE space (the one you open in a browser), the kind of account, your username and password, then save. If you log in through an ENT (no PRONOTE password), leave the password empty and use the "Log in with a QR code" button below. |
| PRONOTE address | `string` | No | The address of the PRONOTE space, as shown by the browser, e.g. https:\/\/0123456a.index-education.net/pronote/. The end of the address (eleve.html, parent.html) is not needed. |
| Kind of account | `select` | No | Student: one student. Parent: every child of the account, one device each. |
| Username | `string` | No |  |
| Password | `secret` | No | Used only when there is no saved session: after the first login, PRONOTE gives a session token that replaces it, kept in the integration's own storage. |
| Refresh interval (min) | `number` | No | How often PRONOTE is read, in minutes. The server is shared by the whole school: 30 minutes is plenty for grades and homework. |
| Homework horizon (days) | `number` | No | How many days of homework are counted and listed, from the next school day (during the holidays, from the return). |
| Time zone of the school | `string` | No | PRONOTE gives times without a time zone: they are read in this one. An IANA name, e.g. Europe/Paris, Indian/Reunion, America/Martinique. |
| Detailed logs (debug) | `boolean` | No | Log every step of the PRONOTE reads. Passwords and tokens are never logged. |

## How to install PRONOTE in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: PRONOTE appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/prohand/gladys-pronote:0.0.11`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/prohand/gladys-pronote](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-pronote).

PRONOTE requires Gladys `>=5.1.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

PRONOTE is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [prohand](https://github.com/prohand), not by the Gladys core team.
